vendors.landing_title: Reach clinics that need what you supply
vendors.landing_lead: Create a free account for your rep office, drug warehouse or supply company. List your products by specialty, send offers to doctors, book visits in the hours clinics set aside for reps, and receive purchase orders by e-mail.
vendors.landing_note: Every new account is reviewed by the {brand} team before clinics can see it.
vendors.register_existing_cta: Register this account as a rep
vendors.benefits_lead: One place to work with the clinics on {brand} — without cold calls or paper catalogues.
vendors.f_reach_text: Choose the specialties you serve — dentistry, dermatology, paediatrics and more. Clinics see what fits their work.
vendors.f_products_text: Add products with photos, pack sizes and optional prices. Clinics can add them to their supply lists in one step.
vendors.f_offers_text: Publish an offer for chosen specialties with a start and end date, and see how many clinics have seen it.
vendors.f_visits_text: Book a visit in the times a doctor or clinic reserves for reps — no waiting in the reception area.
vendors.f_orders_text: When a clinic orders your products, the items and quantities reach you by e-mail and in your portal.
vendors.f_privacy_text: You only ever see clinic and doctor names, visit times and ordered items — never any patient information.
vendors.step1_text: Your company, contact details and the specialties you serve.
vendors.step2_text: The {brand} team approves new accounts, usually within a working day.
vendors.step3_text: Prepare them while you wait — they go live once you are approved.
vendors.step4_text: Visit bookings and purchase orders arrive in your portal and inbox.
vendors.end_text: It takes a few minutes and costs nothing.
